questions.question: What are microorganisms?
questions.answer: Microorganisms are tiny living organisms that can only be seen with a microscope.

questions.question: Bacteria are microorganisms.
Which of the following is a microorganism?
Fill in the blank: Microorganisms are also called ______.
Name one useful microorganism.
Observe the image and identify the microorganism.
Which image shows a fungus?
Some microorganisms can cause diseases.
Fill in the blank: Yeast is used in making ______.
Which microorganism is used to make curd?
What is the role of bacteria in nature?
questions.answer: They help decompose dead plants and animals and recycle nutrients.

questions.question: Viruses are smaller than bacteria.
Observe the image and identify the microorganism.
Which image represents protozoa?
Explain one benefit of microorganisms.
questions.answer: Microorganisms help make foods like curd, bread, and cheese, and they also decompose waste.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Disease-causing microorganisms are called ______.
All microorganisms are harmful.
Which microorganism cannot reproduce without a host cell?
Why are microorganisms important?
questions.answer: They help in food production, decomposition, medicine, and maintaining ecological balance.

questions.question: Explain the difference between useful and harmful microorganisms.
questions.answer: Useful microorganisms help in food production and decomposition, while harmful microorganisms cause diseases and spoil food.
